description: Search Pauhu's sourced index and get cited results as JSON. Input: q (query) and limit. Returns answer, results (id, title, url) and caller_verifies, a verification status: when true, open the cited text before relying on it. For one result's citation link, call source_fetch_fragment with the same q and limit and the result id. A citation shows where the text is quoted from, not that the source's claim is true or current; a general web publisher is one account, not established fact.
name: source_search
title: Source search (agentic resource discovery)
